name: 23188 · Williamsburg, VA
findings: ZIP 23188 (Williamsburg) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23188 (Williamsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 15 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
